dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product shows short waits of unknown length inline — in a button, next to text, in an empty section — and over content, where the indicator needs a container of its own to be seen. Many of its waits end sooner than a person can read a mark, so it decides once how long a wait lasts before its mark is shown, and how the mark enters.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a loading indicator reads: the indicator's size and stroke and the container's size per size, the indicator color on the surface behind it, and — when contained — the container's color, elevation and shape and the indicator color on it, plus the length of one turn, the wait before the indicator is shown, and the kind, length and curve of its entrance.
rules: Use a loading indicator for a short wait whose length is unknown; when the fraction is known, use a determinate progress indicator.
Always give it a label (the accessible name); mark the region being loaded as busy in the product.
Use contained only where the indicator floats over content (pull to refresh, over an image).
Insert the indicator when the wait starts and remove it when the wait ends: the show delay counts from its insertion, so a wait shorter than the delay shows nothing.
Set showDelay, entrance or enterDuration on one indicator only where it needs another pace than the rest; a layer sets these tokens for every indicator.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never draw a spinner of your own.

size.$description: The indicator's square box, per size; the whole component when it is not contained. Small fits in a control in place of an icon, medium next to text, large in an empty section.

thickness.$description: The arc's stroke width, per size. The same stroke at every size by default.

color.$description: The indicator on the surface behind it, when not contained.

size.$description: The container's square box when contained, per size: the indicator plus room around it.

cycle-duration.$description: One full turn of the arc, and one pulse of the reduced-motion form.

show-delay.$description: How long the indicator waits, from the moment it is inserted, before it is drawn and exposed to assistive technology, so that a wait shorter than this shows nothing instead of a mark that flashes. Its box is kept during the wait.

entrance.$description: How the indicator enters once its show delay has passed. fade: the whole component eases its opacity from 0 to 1. grow: it fades the same way and grows from nothing to its full size about its center at the same time. Under reduced motion grow is drawn as fade. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A choice of kind; no dial scales it.

enter-duration.$description: The length of the entrance, fade or grow.

enter-easing.$description: The curve of the entrance: it arrives fast and settles, as an element entering the screen does.
